title: L must straddle k: lacunary floor FALSE-risk only at 2-adic carry resonance
reduced_to: The lacunary floor holds for structural (coset-union) reasons ONLY in characteristic 0. In char p it reduces EXACTLY to the relation-free criterion: whether there exist short {-1,0,1}-coefficient additive relations among the 2^mu-th roots of unity mod q (equivalently, accidental non-coset-union subsets S of mu_n with e_1(S)=...=e_{t-1}(S)=0 mod q). For the prize prime q~n*2^128, n=2^30, this is the open BGK / generalized-Paley sup-norm wall. C034 does not close the floor; it re-derives the already-in-tree DyadicLacunaryFloor reduction and silently assumes its open relation-free input.
wall: BGK / generalized-Paley (relation-free criterion = absence of short {-1,0,1} relations among 2^mu-th roots mod the prize prime)
evidence: Exact integer-mod-q enumeration over real mu_n in real F_q at proper-subgroup large primes (q=1 mod n, q~n^4..6, the prize-faithful regime). PROVEN AFFIRMATIVE (char-0 structure): scripts/probes/_407_conn/C034_lacunary_floor_carry.py (444 cases, n=8,16) + C034_char0_vs_charp_and_image.py confirm vanishingVariety(mu_n,a,t) is EXACTLY the set of unions of mu_{2^L}-cosets (L=ceil(log2 t)): nonempty iff 2^L|a, count EXACTLY C(n/2^L, a/2^L); 0 mismatches; n=32 spot-check 0 mismatches. PRIZE-WINDOW NUMERIC (C034_prize_window_binomial.py): worst-case window-interior resonance binomial C(n/2^L,a/2^L) stays < n (max ratio binom/n ~ 0.45) for all rho in {1/2,1/4,1/8,1/16}, n=2^16..2^40 -- so IF the char-0 structure held mod q the floor would hold with C=1. REFUTATION OF THE CHAR-P CLAIM (C034_accidental_relation_test.py): scanning primes q=1 mod n, the formula FAILS the moment q carries an accidental relation. n=16 examples: q=97 gives #vanishingVariety(mu_16,4,2)=44 not 28, and (a=5,t=2) gives count 16 where C034 predicts 0 (since 2 does not divide 5 -> 'variety empty by carry resonance'); same non-emptiness at non-resonant a for q=113,193,241,401,433. EXPLICIT WITNESS (C034_exhibit_relation.py): at n=16,q=97 the 5-subset of mu_16 with exponents {0,2,4,9,13}, values {1,64,22,89,18}, sums to 0 mod 97; size 5 is odd so it is NOT a coset union -- a pure char-p additive coincidence, directly contradicting 'variety EMPTY unless 2^L|(k+t)'.
honest_note: The PROVEN part (char-0 coset-union structure, exact count C(n/2^L,a/2^L), nonemptiness iff 2^L|a) is correct, clean, axiom-checkable, and a genuinely nice description of WHY the measured incidence is Theta(n) and quantized -- it matches the in-tree lacBad_smul_closed coset-quantization. But C034's headline ('floor automatically TRUE when 2^L does not divide k+t; FALSE-risk only at carry resonance') is FALSE in characteristic p: the structural emptiness is a char-0 phenomenon. The clean small-prime probes (q~n^4) are in the relation-free regime -- exactly the #400 false-positive trap; the prize prime q~2^158 with n=2^30 is not enumerable and whether the short-relation accidents vanish there is the 25-year-open wall. So C034 is a correct, insightful RESTATEMENT/REDUCTION of the existing DyadicLacunaryFloor (its 'relation-free criterion' input), NOT a closure. The (a=5,t=2,q=97) row is a clean machine-checked countermodel to the literal 'carry-resonance dichotomy' claim and should be noted in DISPROOF_LOG as 'char-0-only coset emptiness'. No fabricated closure.
